ns2:section.sectionText: Course Prerequisites: Math 241, Math 285, and Math 415; credit or concurrent enrollment in GE 413 or equivalent course with instructor approval. Description: Introduction to advanced integrated methods for dynamic engineering system design. Students will propose term projects that combine physical and control system design. This course will step through the integrated design process phases, including modeling, simulation, optimal physical and control system design, and co-design. Students will demonstrate knowledge of each phase using their chosen case study.
